# Animated Circuit Generator

Animated Circuit Generator is an MIT-licensed Vite static app that creates animated SVG circuit snippets for websites.

Primary user flow:
1. Select one of twenty built-in circuit presets or paste a custom SVG.
2. Choose an animation mode: flow, pulse, draw, shimmer, or paused.
3. Adjust speed, dash length, stroke width, glow, stagger, scale, opacity, line caps, line joins, node fill, circuit color, direction, background, texture, and padding.
4. Copy SVG, CSS, complete embed HTML, or an AI implementation prompt.

Implementation API:
- SVG class: animated-circuit
- Animation classes: circuit-flow, circuit-pulse, circuit-draw, circuit-shimmer, circuit-paused
- Texture classes: circuit-pattern-none, circuit-pattern-grid, circuit-pattern-scanlines, circuit-pattern-dots
- CSS variables: --circuit-color, --circuit-bg, --circuit-bg-alt, --circuit-speed, --circuit-stroke, --circuit-glow, --circuit-dash, --circuit-opacity, --circuit-linecap, --circuit-linejoin, --circuit-node-fill, --circuit-direction, --circuit-padding

Important files:
- src/circuit-presets/ contains the built-in SVG presets split by category.
- src/circuit-presets/index.js exports circuitCategories and the flat circuits array.
- src/main.js builds the live preview and generated snippets.
- src/styles.css contains UI styles and the reusable animation CSS.
- AI.md gives implementation guidance for code models.

License: MIT.
